erratum_to: E11_kv_lattice_prereg.json (unchanged; its sha256 stays recorded in the raw files)
text: The pre-registration states that Gemma-4-E4B runs in bf16 "because Gemma activations overflow in fp16". That was an assumption, not a measurement: fp16 was never tried on Gemma-4-E4B. The correct statement is that Gemma ran in bf16, the dtype of its checkpoint, and that fp16 was not tried. The choice of bf16 did not depend on any result.
affects: the stated rationale only; no design element, number or decision
